We are looking for an enthusiastic Senior Scientist / Principal Scientist in Embedded AI and Ubiquitous Computing (f/m/d) at University of Freiburg -

To lead research on Embedded Artificial Intelligence (Embedded AI), Ubiquitous Computing, and Digital Health, as well as support education at bachelor, master, and Ph.D. level in Embedded AI.

Position is intended to be full-time and permanent.

Please apply fast - links to position details are below.
